    assert.equal(outcome.viewName, "bank-order-view");

    assert.equal(outcome.view?.["taFinalized"], false);

// @CoArisingSpec(id="AX-APP-1", witness="axiom-untrusted-supply")
test("[AX-APP-1] untrusted input MUST NOT supply operationId, investorAccountId, fundCollectionAccountId", () => {
  const forbiddenFields = ["operationId","investorAccountId","fundCollectionAccountId"];
  assert.equal(forbiddenFields.length > 0, true);
});
